annotations.title: Change a board's purpose or notes

tools.description: Replace a board's notes, its purpose, or both; leave out what should not change. A board's purpose can only be written while its Purpose section is on, which a person does in Board settings (409 purpose_off otherwise). Each is the whole new markdown text, so to add a link, send the old notes with it added. Each needs the rev it was read at, from get_board_notes or get_board: if someone edited the text since, the change is refused (409 board_text_stale) rather than written over theirs; read it again and redo the change on top. Needs edit rights on the board.

tools.description: Change any of a card's fields; leave out what should not change. Pass the card's rev when changing title or description: if someone edited it since, the change is refused (409 card_stale, with the card as it now stands) rather than written over theirs.
